scope: Numeric usage evidence for all 96 first-attempt cells; no model calls, grading or theorem checking were performed.

input_bindings.cell_record_binding: Every original_record_sha256 equals the original_record_sha256 in the corresponding exported cells/<cell_id>/record.json.

anonymization.request_ids: SHA-256 over the original message_id UTF-8 bytes. Hash equality preserves duplicate detection.
anonymization.source_identification: Original record and attempt receipt SHA-256 hashes; no original filesystem paths.
anonymization.excluded: Provider streams, prompts and generated text, account identifiers, credentials, environment details, machine paths, collaborator commentary and live token estimates.

normalization.claude: inputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + outputTokens; per-request equivalents retain snake_case names.
normalization.gpt_oss: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens; reasoning_tokens is recorded as a subset and is not added a second time.
normalization.partial: If native is null, sum only saved per-request token fields and retain the lower-bound flag.
normalization.request_counts: The saved provider_requests_observed equals the number of unique per-request rows in each physical attempt.
